senses.gloss: to gnaw, eat, consume. Inf. in Y. freq. לוֹכַל = לֶאֱכוֹל.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:1">Ber. I, 1</cite>; a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 7:7:4">Y. Shebu. VII, 38ᵃ</cite> <he>בשרבית אוֹכֶלֶת בו</he> when interests gnaw on (absorb) the property.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 4:3:2">Y. Erub. IV, 21ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>ד׳ אמות אוֹכְלוֹת וכ׳</he> four cubits entering into the area of Tiberias.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:20">Num. R. s. 4</cite> <he>כמה לוחות אוֹכְלוֹת</he> how much space did the tablets occupy &c.? <cite ref="Bava Batra 14a">B. Bath. 14ᵃ</cite> (interchanging with <he>איגרות</he>, Var. <he>אוגדות</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 5, 6).
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:9">Keth. V, 9</cite>, differ. of opin.
<cite ref="Ketubot 65b:6">ib. 65ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. 30ᵇ top a. bot.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 1:3">Zeb. I, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:1">Ber. I, 1</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 1:4">Tam. I, 4</cite> <he>המְאוּכָּלוֹת הפנימיות</he> (Talm. ed. <he>המעו׳</he>) the thoroughly lighted coals in the centre; Y. Yoma II, 39ᶜ

senses.gloss: to give to eat, cause to eat.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:3">Keth. V, 3</cite> <he>היבם אינו מַאֵכִיל וכ׳</he> the Yabam does not transfer the privilege of eating T’rumah to his sister-in-law.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 31a:14">Kidd. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>יש מאכיל וכ׳</he> one may feed his father on pheasants &c.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 8:7">Ber. VIII, 7</cite> <he>עד כדי שיִתְאַכֵּל וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>שיתע׳</he>) until the food is digested (or absorbed) in his bowels.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 6:12">Snh. VI, 12</cite> Y. ed. <he>נתא׳ הבשר</he> (Mish. ib. VI, 6 <he>נתע׳</he>) when the flesh of the corpse was gone.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> <he>שלא נתא׳ אחת מהן</he> none of them was worn off.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 59a:9">Kidd. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>נתא׳ המעות</he> the money was spent; a. e.
